scope_note: A facsimile of the movement's own papers handed to the President of the RSFSR (archival copies from the Presidential Archive, fund 91, published by the Yeltsin Center as Ф. 6. Оп. 1. Д. 104. Л. 1-18). Leaves 1 and 5 were read for the co-chairs' signatures and the plenum of the Council of Representatives. The list on leaf 6 (the participants of 12 October 1991, with full names and no titles) and the statements on leaves 7-18 state no office and are not imported. The recorded identity is a raw Internet Archive capture made before the cutoff, byte-identical to the live static file.

edition_and_host.edition: Facsimile of archival copies, 18 leaves (handwritten leaf numbers 1-18): l. 1 a handwritten letter of the movement's Coordinating Council to the President of the RSFSR, dated '12.09.91' and registered '12,10,1991 № 03540'; l. 5 a typed list of the Council of Representatives' delegation signed by a co-chair; l. 6 a typed list headed '12 октября, 12 час.'; ll. 7-18 statements of the Council of Representatives.
edition_and_host.host: yeltsin.ru, the online archive of the Президентский центр Б. Н. Ельцина (Yeltsin Presidential Center, a nonprofit foundation): facsimile PDFs (page images, no text layer) of copies of documents of the Archive of the President of the Russian Federation, fund 91 op. 1, catalogued by the Center as 'Ф. 6. Оп. 1'. The PDFs are static files (fixed Last-Modified and ETag); the item description pages (yeltsin.ru/archive/paperwork/<id>/) are dynamic and are locators only.

visual_review.method: Every page of the 18-page facsimile was rendered from the recorded bytes and read from the image (the file has no text layer); leaves 1 (the handwritten letter, with its date and registration mark enlarged) and 5 (the typed list and its signature line enlarged) carry the quotations, and leaf 6 was read for the meeting of 12 October 1991.
